words.def: n. a person who is extremely enthusiastic about something
v. to move in continuous circles, going upwards or downwards
v. to squeeze something tightly, such as facial muscles
v. to travel to or around an area in order to learn about it
v. to become filled with surprise, wonder, or amazement
v. to run with quick short steps
n. a state of not being certain about what is happening
v. to have a difficult time doing or understanding something
adj. not working; not functioning correctly
adj. acceptable and appropriate in a particular situation
n. a strong feeling such as love, fear, or anger
v. to run very quickly for a short distance
v. to fail to hit, catch, or reach something
v. to hear a conversation in which you are not involved
v. to walk somewhere quickly in a determined way
v. to slope downwards
v. to fly very high in the air or remain high in the air
n. someone who is good at something without much effort
adj. not changing and not interrupted
adj. very hot in a way that makes you feel uncomfortable
v. to make something by putting parts together
n. the outside or top layer of something
adj. relating to the process of developing from a child into an adult
adj. having the ability or qualities necessary for doing something
